purpose: Portable input bundle so Grok Build can reconstruct, test and push the verified EduOS release into the canonical GitHub repository.

required_canonical_base.note: Apply the codebase/ tree onto a clean checkout of this commit; this bundle was produced outside that repository and contains no git history.

production_statement: Production was untouched. No production write, migration, publication or deployment occurred while producing this bundle. No database mutation of any kind was performed.
exclusions: .env (runtime environment file) — replaced by codebase/.env.example with empty values
database exports containing users, learners, payments or PII
build outputs (dist, .output), node_modules, caches (__pycache__), temporary files
git history and Lovable platform metadata
two real personal email addresses and names in codebase/EDUOS_PARENT_SIGNUP_PRODUCTION_FIX.md were redacted as [REDACTED_EMAIL_*] / [REDACTED_NAME_*]
